body.query: What was the average monthly consumption of customers in SME for the year 2013?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT AVG(y.consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
